records.question: How many orders are pending?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

records.question: How many customers are from Delhi?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_from_delhi FROM customers c WHERE c.city = 'Delhi'

records.question: What is the price of the cheapest product?
records.generated_sql: SELECT MIN(price) AS cheapest_product_price FROM products

records.question: How many payments failed?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_payments FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'failed'

records.question: How many products are in the Books category?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS books_category_products FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Books'

records.question: How many orders were shipped?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_shipped FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped'

records.question: What is the total refunded amount?
records.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS total_refunded_amount FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'refunded'

records.question: How many orders were placed by customers from Pune?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_placed FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Pune'

records.question: What is the average price of products in the Fashion category?
records.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(pr.price) AS average_price FROM products pr JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = pr.category_id WHERE cat.category_name = 'Fashion'

records.question: Which city generates the highest revenue?
records.generated_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the total stock quantity across all products?
records.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(stock_quantity) AS total_stock_quantity FROM products

records.question: How many orders were placed in the first quarter of 2025?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_placed FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01'

records.question: What is the revenue of each payment method?
records.generated_sql: SELECT p.payment_method, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.payment_method ORDER BY revenue DESC

records.question: How many orders contain more than 2 different products?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_more_than_2_products FROM (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 2
) AS orders_with_more_than_2_products

records.question: How many customers from Maharashtra have spent more than 20000 in total?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers_spent_more_than_20000 FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE c.state = 'Maharashtra' AND p.amount > 20000

records.question: How many customers have ordered products from at least 3 different categories?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers_with_3_or_more_categories FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products pr ON oi.product_id = pr.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pr.category_id) >= 3

records.question: What is the total revenue from customers in Karnataka?
records.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.state = 'Karnataka' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')

records.question: How many customers placed orders in both 2024 and 2025?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers_placed_orders_in_both_years FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' INTERSECT SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers_placed_orders_in_both_years FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01'

records.question: What is the total value of items in cancelled orders (quantity times unit price)?
records.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
